items.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware
items.summary: German lawmakers and a filmmaker are among the people who received notifications from Apple warning that their phones may have been hacked.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
items.summary: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek

items.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
items.summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders
items.summary: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
